label: PF Backlog 171
title: Context fidelity: no silent input truncation + chunk-merge for large required inputs
body: DONE: agent_runner._build_agent_prompt no longer truncates/breaks. Required (recent) artifacts stay FULL; if the assembled prompt exceeds model context the LLM client SPLITS+MERGES (map-reduce, no loss). Ambient (older) artifacts get a structured compact (never a 500-char slice / silent drop). Compact summaries: removed the hard 3KB cap (project_journal._compact_text, ArtifactSummarizer.summarize max_chars=0=open, checkpoint caller). OPEN: explicit per-agent config/context-policy.json (which inputs FULL vs SUMMARY), fidelity audit (record CONTENT chars passed per artifact - current audit records path length), and a completeness gate (fail/clarify if a declared-FULL input is missing/summarized).
_note: Context fidelity DONE: core/context_policy.py + config/context-policy.json (declared full_stages per agent + recent_full); _build_agent_prompt applies the policy, records FIDELITY (name/mode/content-chars passed) and GAPS (declared-FULL inputs reduced/missing, logged '[CONTEXT-GAP]'); audit artifacts_used now records CONTENT chars (was path length). No silent truncation; required inputs FULL (chunk-merge downstream); ambient summarised. compileall=0 wired_audit=0.
